name: Filmcity Media Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Filmcity Media Ltd is in the business of Film production, Distribution and Exhibition[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
FML is a media sector company. It started business with a private label magazine publication and later diversified into electronic 
media by setting up a video studio with complete shooting and post production equipment. It has produced many programmes 
for Door darshan National and other channels like Zee TV, Star Plus, and other private networks, including OTTs

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -4.75% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 199 days.
